messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident fired — p95/p99 latency SLO burn in eu-west. Trigger: alerting-service > 3min above p95 threshold. Pager: oncall@redwood (P1). link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-1820129999
amanda: ACK. I'm on it. starting quick triage — checking hot paths and recent deploys
nate: +1. seeing p95 jump on inference-sidecar pods, not control plane. CPU on GPUs looks normal, tail latency on model-serving pods up ~3x
olivia: grabbing logs, adding KV-cache and batching metrics to dashboard now. any customer reports?
amanda: no customer tickets yet, but spikes line up with a spike in short-sequence small-batch traffic at 09:13 UTC
mike: I can flip routing to dedicated pool (eu-west-dedicated-a) if we need capacity isolate. that's a ~1min change with quick rollback
amate: (typo) meant to say: can we try increasing sidecar batch timeout to allow larger batches? risk = slight added latency for some requests
amanda: hold on config change until we confirm cause. Olivia, can you confirm if KV-cache eviction increased?
olivia: KV evictions up ~80% on a subset of pods. hotkey pattern emerges from a small customer test traffic pattern. suspect cache thrash causing repeated model hotpath regen
mike: ok switching small percentage (5%) of traffic to fallback-model-compact for that customer group to reduce memory pressure, will monitor
amate: nate again — my bad for name glitch earlier. monitoring batching metrics now
amanda: nice. incident-bot: please suppress duplicate pages for same signal for 10m while we stabilize
incident-bot: action taken: alert suppression set for 10m window by oncall
sre-bot: notated runbook step: 1) Identify hotkey origin, 2) divert traffic, 3) KV-cache warmup, 4) observe p95 drop, 5) escalate to eng-platform if not resolved in 15m
amanda: Nate/Mike — after divert, if p95 still > SLO in 10m we do dedicated-pool failover and open customer-facing note
mike: divert applied to 5% -> 15% over next 60s. reducing cache eviction pressure on affected pods. rolling steady
olivia: metrics: eviction rate beginning to decay after 2m. p95 trending down from 520ms -> 240ms on affected pods
amanda: good signal. keep suppression for 10m and continue monitoring. please update pagerduty status to "under investigation" and set ETA 20m
pagerduty: Incident status updated to: under investigation. ETA set to 20m. responders: amanda, nate, olivia, mike
amanda: tagging product: @olivia please capture any notable customer IDs requesting small-sequence bursts so we can reach out after postmortem
olivia: noted. I've flagged 3 internal test clients and one external beta org — will collect request ids and timeline
sre-bot: reminder — capture heap snapshots and sidecar logs for 30s window starting at 09:12:10 UTC for bound analysis
amanda: will do. thanks all. next update in 10m or on material changes :thumbsup:
